Lemma
[Orthogonality to the gradient characterizes the kernel of the differential]

↗ def:gradient ↗ lem:gradient-characterization

Let $(M,g)$ be a finite-dimensional Riemannian manifold, $f\colon M\to \mathbb R$ smooth, $p\in M$, and $w\in T_pM$. Then \[ \langle \operatorname {grad}f|_p,w\rangle =0 \quad \Longleftrightarrow \quad df_p(w)=0. \]

Proof

↗ lem:gradient-characterization \sketch This is immediate from (2.14).

□
